mechanism: Store the fixed SF distance cost in five unused high bits of each retained match item, in integer bits. Unpack the original token before length/distance use. The ordinary, seed and repeatedprefix solvers consume the storedprice instead of recomputing distancecode and loading its cost each time.
difference_from_old_work: The SFtable producer uses16-unit prices andatmost15Huffman+13extra bits; the encoding carries0..31bit costs. This is immutable per-block edge metadata, not anotherlookupcache or changedprice objective. Actual runtime range and priceidentity are checked before timing.
